## Remote DB + RPostgres R Package
```{r}
library(DBI)
library(odbc)

pwd <- readLines("../../hashcx/api-keys/neon.tech-ds212.pwd")

con <- dbConnect(
  RPostgres::Postgres(),
  host     = "ep-patient-cell-bd0cj75h-pooler.c-8.us-east-2.aws.neon.tech", # Remote host
  port     = 5432,
  dbname   = "neondb",
  user     = "neondb_owner",
  password = pwd,
  sslmode  = "require"
)

dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(50),
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  );
")

dbExecute(con, "
  INSERT INTO users (name) 
  VALUES ('Alice'), ('Bob');
")

result <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM users LIMIT 10")
print(result)

dbDisconnect(con)
```
